name: Empty motorway
desc: Open road with nobody on it - for leaving, for the long drive, for the wrong kind of quiet.
tags: empty motorway, multiple lanes, white lane markings, crash barrier, overhead gantry sign, sodium street lights, road studs, hard shoulder, flat horizon, asphalt receding into distance
prose: a wide empty motorway running to a flat horizon, white lane markings stretching ahead between crash barriers, overhead gantry signs and a receding line of sodium lamps
note: The hardest thing here is the emptiness. The model fills motorways with traffic by default and asking for no cars does nothing at all - it only holds if the frame is built out of road furniture instead, so barrier, gantry, lamp posts and markings receding are carrying the whole shot. If one vehicle is wanted, name that one vehicle. Without the furniture tags you get either a jam or a featureless grey band.
